summary: Authored ADR-001 (deterministic grader) and design/TASK-001.aol; ADR-001 rewritten to remove a contradiction in the prior draft.
decisions: Verdict is two-valued (COMPLIANT|NONCOMPLIANT); reason_code is diagnostic only.
Prior ADR draft declared a third MALFORMED verdict while also requiring malformed=noncompliant; contradiction removed.
Attribution failure is a rejected harness defect, never scored against an arm (INV-004).
Strict whole-response JSON parse; no fence-strip, no embedded-JSON extraction, no substring match (INV-001).
Tallies store integer numerator/denominator; rate computed at report edge.
grader_version + response_sha256 on every verdict; normalization change requires version bump and re-grade.
deferred: DEFER-001: grading actions/role_performed deferred to ADR-002
open_questions: RSK-001 mitigation is owned by the RUNNER boundary (format instruction must sit in the shared scaffold, identical across arms). Out of TASK-001 scope; needs an owner.
next_reason: ARCH cannot approve its own design (core/ROLES.aol SOD=ARCH!=ARCH_REVIEW). architecture.aol records ADR:ADR-001=ACTIVE while the ADR is Proposed; ARCH_REVIEW must reconcile that on approval.
